note: What the route signposts say. tools/signposts.py places a post at every town exit (both ends of every route leg), every sub-region transition along a leg, and every junction where a place's own path leaves a route. The front of each sign faces the traveller going the way the text names; the back faces the other way. Names are working names until the towns have display names; change them here and re-run the tool.
why_offset: beside the road, on the traveller's right, never on it

junctions.why: the forest's mansion spur leaves Route 1 here (tools/maze_forest.py spur_mansion)

no_sign.displaced_city: hidden on purpose: the waystone inside is the reward for finding it once
